purpose: Turn NetCoin from architecture-complete into evidence-driven: every core lane must have an explicit proof gate, a strict local command, and a sandbox-safe source-check fallback.
principles: No broad new product surfaces in Phase 1.
Every readiness claim must name the command that proves it.
Sandbox/source-only validation is useful but cannot be marketed as production proof.
Strict mode requires real Python, Cargo, npm, Playwright, and security/audit gates where applicable.
Reports should be written to reports/ so regressions can be compared release-to-release.

sandbox.description: Runs deterministic Python/source checks when external tools such as Cargo, npm installs, or Playwright are missing.

strict.description: Runs the real external execution gates that must pass before any professional/mainnet candidate claim.
strict.allowed_for_release_claim: professional candidate after all gates pass

gate_groups.label: Python Reference Proof
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: Python remains the canonical reference only if the full suite can pass consistently.

gate_groups.label: Rust Workspace Build Proof
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: Rust migration stops being structural-only and becomes compiled/tested.

gate_groups.label: All Rust Executable Parity
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: Every Rust lane must execute against frozen Python vectors, not just exist in source form.

gate_groups.label: TypeScript API Contract Proof
strict_commands: cd api && npm ci && npm run ci:api
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: The server, client, schemas, and OpenAPI contract stay synchronized.

gate_groups.label: Browser Product E2E Proof
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: UI flows are proven in a browser instead of only source-checked.

gate_groups.label: Accessibility Proof
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: The UI can be considered professional only after keyboard, labels, contrast, and breakpoint checks are tracked.

gate_groups.label: Security and Release Proof
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: Release artifacts become auditable and reproducible enough for external review.

gate_groups.label: Phase 0 Product Guardrails
gate_groups.hard_ceiling_removed: Proof hardening does not regress the product architecture completed in Phase 0.

release_readiness_scorecard.minimum_for_phase1_source_checked: all sandbox-required gates pass or produce source_only with explicit caveat
release_readiness_scorecard.minimum_for_professional_candidate: all strict gates pass with no source_only, blocked, fail, or not_run statuses

phase1_exit_criteria: All Rust parity binaries execute successfully without --allow-missing-cargo.
Full Python test suite report is green or every remaining failure has a tracked blocker.
npm ci && npm run ci:api passes from a clean api/ directory.
Playwright product matrix runs against wallet, explorer, markets, faucet, operator, exchange, and release verify.
Accessibility source matrix exists and strict accessibility execution is planned or green.
Release readiness scorecard is generated for every release.
non_goals: No new markets/products/custody features unless they directly support proof gates.
No claiming mainnet/professional readiness from sandbox-only evidence.
